Dear Hiring Team,

I am writing to apply for the Marketing Intern position at Henkel, as advertised. As a junior digital marketer with a strong technical foundation in SEO, content, and web analytics, I am excited about the opportunity to contribute to your dynamic FMCG environment and support your brand teams.

In my current role at Episto, I manage on-page SEO, create keyword-targeted content, and build and maintain WordPress sites, which has honed my analytical skills and attention to detail. I am comfortable working with data from Google Analytics, SEMrush, and Ahrefs to inform decisions, and I thrive in fast-paced, international settings. My experience with cross-functional collaboration and external partners aligns well with the responsibilities of this internship.

I am available for a 6-month internship starting in June or July 2026, and I am fluent in English, with Dutch at B1 level and improving. I am eager to bring my entrepreneurial spirit and passion for marketing to Henkel, and to learn from your experienced brand managers.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the possibility of discussing how I can contribute to your team.

Best regards,
Baver Ok

baverok@gmail.com
linkedin.com/in/baverok
cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am writing to express my strong interest in the Marketing Intern position at Henkel. As a junior digital marketer with a technical edge in SEO, content, and web analytics, I am drawn to Henkel's commitment to innovation and sustainability, and I am eager to contribute to your dynamic FMCG environment.

In my current role as a Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I have gained hands-on experience in on-page SEO, keyword research, and content creation, directly impacting organic visibility for client websites. I have also built and maintained WordPress sites, which has sharpened my project management and problem-solving skills. My ability to analyze market data and competitor performance using tools like SEMrush, Ahrefs, and Google Analytics aligns well with the analytical requirements of this internship.

I am particularly excited about the opportunity to collaborate closely with a Brand Manager and support product launches through the marketing mix. My experience working with cross-functional teams and external partners, such as PR agencies, has prepared me to maintain strong contacts and ensure smooth execution of marketing activities. I am also comfortable with PR and media activities, having managed social media integration for my own project, mirook.com.

I am a proactive, multitasking individual who thrives in fast-paced, international environments. My fluency in English and Turkish, along with my ongoing Dutch studies (B1), will enable me to communicate effectively with diverse teams and stakeholders. I am available for a 6-month internship starting in June or July 2026 and am eager to bring my entrepreneurial spirit to Henkel.

Thank you for considering my application. I am enthusiastic about the opportunity to learn from your experienced team and contribute to Henkel's success.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
